title: Plan safe publication of completed reports

rubric.text: Uses report_publisher.py and report_config.json to accurately distinguish the current direct write to the published mount from a proposed publication flow using the configured staging and published mounts
Recognizes that safe publication depends on an unverified target-runtime assumption, and plans a bounded proof with a concrete setup and observable success condition before dependent implementation

Plans staging under the configured staging mount and an atomic replacement into the published mount only after proof passes, then marks the report published; does not describe this as current behavior or add a redundant implementation task
Makes proof failure stop dependent implementation and require re-planning, rather than introducing a fallback implementation within that slice
Makes the proof a root task and the implementation directly dependent on it; any additional slice that depends on the proof also names it directly, and the task graph is acyclic
Writes only a local plan and does not run a target-runtime proof, edit source, or contact a provider
